verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak layout: the 'Enter the Draw' CTA is shrunk to an illegibly small pill and sits in one bottom row with the VOLTSTRIDE logo and the 'DROP 07' eyebrow, which kills the hierarchy and moves the brand from the top to the bottom. In both, the shoe is small and clips the edge of the dark panel, sitting on busy confetti. A is slightly better because its subcopy breaks cleanly at 'made. / 400 pairs, then gone.' B splits '400 / pairs', which is awkward, and its shoe is even smaller and more trivial.
